lines.en: Ugh! Why does everything happen to me?
But, Rich, I promise, first thing tomorrow,
we'll find another doctor, but I gotta go to Burley,
and I'm not feeling all that well.
What? Why do you mean you're not feeling well?
What do you have? Is it rubella?
Because don't go near Emma, she has not had that shot.
You know, come to think of it, it does feel rubella-like.
Right! Now he's gonna know it was me!
